name: SentimenTrader
zh_summary: SentimenTrader指出，同樣的情緒信號取決於其所處的趨勢，可能意味相反的結果。工業股對必需消費股的翻轉剛出現；在上升趨勢中，未來數月偏向正面，而脫離情境的過去案例中近一半來自2000年和2008年熊市。證據權重：建設性、選擇性。涵蓋美國股票、必需消費股、金礦股、比特幣。
text:
The same sentiment signal can mean opposite things depending on one thing: the trend it shows up in. An industrials versus staples flip just fired, and whether it’s bullish hinges entirely on context. Inside an uptrend the next few months lean positive. Pulled out of context, nearly half the past cases came from the 2000 and 2008 bear markets.

Four reports this week. Weight of Evidence: Constructive, selective.

U.S. Stocks • Staples • Gold Miners • Bitcoin
